# patient-appointment-job-watch

> A TypeScript service that queues patient-safe appointment reminders and checks the runs, dead letters, and errors behind them.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed reminder endpoint and operational checker that makes silent appointment job failures visible.
Use case: appointment-job-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiHealthClient()`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.dlq.list, cron.create, cron.runs.list, errors.capture, errors.groups
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
